title: Shop Small, Win a Prize: Laredo Chamber Marks Small Business Saturday Nov. 28
excerpt: The Laredo Chamber of Commerce is urging shoppers to spend Small Business Saturday, Nov. 28, at local shops — and a photo of the purchase could win a prize.
content:
Small Business Saturday is tomorrow, Saturday, Nov. 28, and the Laredo Chamber of Commerce is giving shoppers one more reason to shop local: a chance to win a prize.

To enter, buy something from any small business in Laredo on Saturday, Nov. 28. Then take a photo of the purchase and post it publicly on Instagram or Facebook, tagging the Laredo Chamber of Commerce. Both the purchase and the post must happen on Saturday to count.

The Chamber will announce the winner Monday, Nov. 30, on social media and will message the winner directly.

The Chamber kicked off the season with a Small Business Saturday proclamation ceremony Nov. 20 at De La Fuente Insurance Group, and its Shop Small Pass Card runs through Dec. 31.

Sources: Laredo Chamber of Commerce.
